name: Jarvis
author: VGS
description: Talk to a voice assistant. Turning Jarvis off ends the session and prevents automatic starts.

settings.privateWindows: 1password, bitwarden, keepass, proton pass, enpass, pinentry, seahorse, private browsing, incognito

mode.label: Talk mode
mode.info: Hold: speak while you hold Talk, then release it to send your words. Toggle: press Talk to open or close the conversation. Always: say Hey Jarvis, then your request. Talk starts listening at once. Always needs the local voice and keeps the microphone open on this computer.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.description: Choose the microphone for a cloud voice
microphone.info: The local voice uses the system default microphone, as dictation does. Set feedback tones in [Appearance → Sounds](page:vgs.sounds).

speaker.label: Speaker
speaker.info: Jarvis closes its microphone while it speaks. Press Talk to interrupt speech.

voiceProvider.label: Voice provider
voiceProvider.info: Local is the default. Realtime sends your voice to OpenAI, and Gemini Live sends it to Google; both answer more slowly. ElevenLabs speaks the replies in your ElevenLabs voices, and Local still hears you. Auto uses Realtime when an OpenAI key is stored and Talk mode is not Always; otherwise it uses Local, never ElevenLabs. Changing this ends the conversation.

voiceAccount.label: Voice key
voiceAccount.description: Your key for the cloud voice: an OpenAI key from OpenAI API keys for Realtime, a Gemini key for Gemini Live or an ElevenLabs key for ElevenLabs
voiceAccount.info: With one stored key for the chosen voice, Jarvis picks it. [Add provider keys beside API keys on the Details tab](page:vgs.jarvis/Details).

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: Who Jarvis sounds like, from the voices of the selected voice provider
voice.info: With ElevenLabs, these are the voices of your account. Changing this ends the conversation.

localTier.label: Local voice model
localTier.description: Choose the model for the voice Jarvis speaks with
localTier.info: Auto selects a model for this computer. Choosing another model downloads it now. Dictation uses a separate voxtype model: change it with Choose model in [Voice Details](page:vgs.voice/Details).

clonedVoice.label: Cloned voice
clonedVoice.description: Let Jarvis speak in your recorded voice
clonedVoice.info: Use your own voice or one you have permission to use. The recording and model stay on this computer. Jarvis uses Chatterbox Turbo by Resemble AI, under the MIT licence. It needs the Large local voice model and an NVIDIA graphics card. Changing this ends the conversation.

brain.label: Account
brain.description: The account Jarvis asks: an API key you added, or an app you are signed in to

model.label: Model
model.description: The model that answers you, from the list that the app or API key you chose above offers

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: Choose how much the model thinks before it answers
effort.info: More effort takes longer. Changing this ends the conversation.

fallbacks.label: Backup models
fallbacks.description: Choose the models Jarvis tries if the answering app refuses or stops
fallbacks.info: Jarvis tries these models in the listed order. It sends only the last request. It does not send the earlier conversation. Changing this ends the conversation.

brain.label: Account
brain.description: The account Jarvis tries next: an API key or an app

model.label: Model
model.description: Empty uses Jarvis's normal default for that app or key

home.label: Home folder
home.description: Choose the folder that holds what Jarvis knows
home.info: The home folder holds what Jarvis knows: your instructions in AGENTS.md, your memory notes and your skills. Every AI model you choose reads them. Choose the folder where you want to keep them. Changing the folder ends the conversation.

startAtBoot.label: Start Jarvis at boot
startAtBoot.description: When VGS starts after you sign in, a tmux session starts Jarvis in your selected home folder
startAtBoot.info: Turn this on to start Jarvis each time you sign in, so it is ready when you press Talk.

bootSession.label: Session at boot
bootSession.description: Choose the session Jarvis starts at the next boot
bootSession.info: This choice does not replace a session that is already running. Resume the last session: resume your saved conversation and check its unfinished work. If that conversation is unavailable, a new session continues the saved work. Start a new session: start a fresh conversation and continue the work saved in your Jarvis home. This does not erase your work.

taskTerminal.label: Task terminal
taskTerminal.info: Auto uses tmux when it is installed. tmux runs several tasks at once. The floating terminal shows one task at a time.

cloudVision.label: Screen to cloud
cloudVision.description: Choose whether Jarvis can send screen images or text outside this computer
cloudVision.info: Allow sends screen images or text to the selected AI model or voice outside this computer. Never blocks sending them outside this computer. Ask sends them only after you allow it for the conversation. An AI model and voice that both run on this computer always receive them. Changing this ends the conversation.

privateWindows.label: Private windows

presets.value: 1password, bitwarden, keepass, proton pass, enpass, pinentry, seahorse, private browsing, incognito
presets.label: Password managers and private browsing

privateWindows.description: Choose which windows Jarvis hides in screenshots
privateWindows.info: Separate the words with commas. Jarvis paints a window black if its class or title contains one of these words. It does this before a screenshot leaves Jarvis. This protection is limited: a title cannot reliably identify private browsing.

feedback.label: Feedback sounds
feedback.description: A sound tells you when the AI is still working. With the local voice, the dictation tones you set in Voice tell you when to speak.

binds.info: Hold the keys and speak to Jarvis. In Hold talk mode, Jarvis takes what you said when you let go; in Toggle mode the conversation stays open. Pressing it while Jarvis speaks interrupts it.
Turns the Jarvis microphone off, or on again. Mute stays on after a restart, and Talk does nothing while it is on.
Ends what Jarvis is doing now: listening, thinking or speaking.
Confirms the Jarvis request shown on screen.
Opens the Jarvis console window for typed messages.

shell.label: Shell tools
shell.hint: Jarvis runs shell commands only when it can protect your files
shell.info: Shell tools let Jarvis run commands on this computer for the tasks you ask it to do. They stay off when this computer cannot keep your private files safe from those commands.

daemon.label: Jarvis readiness
daemon.hint: Starting Jarvis does not turn on your microphone

keys.label: Provider keys
keys.hint: This check never reads a key or unlocks the keyring

keyStore.label: API keys
keyStore.hint: Stores provider keys in your keyring

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.hint: Signed in does not prove that the AI answers. A test request may cost money.

voicePreview.label: Voice preview
voicePreview.hint: Jarvis says one sentence in the chosen voice

voiceKey.label: Cloud voice key
voiceKey.hint: Get an OpenAI key from OpenAI API keys for Realtime or a Gemini key from Google AI Studio for Gemini Live
voiceKey.info: Realtime and Gemini Live send your voice to the provider. Add key stores the key in your keyring.

voiceRoute.label: Voice provider
voiceRoute.hint: Where your voice and the replies go with the chosen voice provider
voiceRoute.info: Auto uses Realtime with your OpenAI voice key, except in Always talk mode. Realtime sends your voice and approved replies to OpenAI. Otherwise Auto uses Local, which keeps speech on this computer.

elevenLabs.label: ElevenLabs voices
elevenLabs.hint: Get a key from ElevenLabs API keys, store it with Add key on the API keys line, then choose it in [Voice key](page:vgs.jarvis/Settings/voiceAccount)
elevenLabs.info: These are the voices of your ElevenLabs account, which you choose under Voice. Design or clone a new voice on ElevenLabs's site, under Voices.

localRuntime.label: Local voice
localRuntime.hint: The voice that runs on this computer, with the model chosen in [Local voice model](page:vgs.jarvis/Settings/localTier)
localRuntime.info: The local voice keeps your speech on this computer. Its setup downloads the voice models and checks that they can run, without opening the microphone or speakers. Setup runs from the Voice step while the selected voice provider needs the local voice, and when you choose another Local voice model.

clonedVoiceSetup.label: Cloned voice
clonedVoiceSetup.hint: Lets Jarvis speak in a voice recorded on this computer after you set it up
clonedVoiceSetup.info: Remove recording deletes the recording and turns off Cloned voice when its terminal closes. The model stays on this computer for a later setup.

personality.label: Personality
personality.info: Personality is how Jarvis talks to you. Press Edit to change it.

startText.label: Conversation start text
startText.hint: An estimate from the size of each text, so the AI model's own count can differ
startText.info: Jarvis sends these texts to the AI model at the start of every conversation. The model reads text as tokens, which are small pieces of words. More tokens make each answer slower and can cost more, so each file has a budget. Jarvis still reads a file over its budget, whole. To use fewer tokens, make that file shorter. The total also counts the guidance that Jarvis itself sends.

sessionStart.label: Jarvis session
sessionStart.info: If no previous session was saved, Jarvis starts a new session. If the saved conversation is unavailable, a new session continues your saved work. If another session uses the Jarvis terminal, close it or choose its home folder. Automatic start stays off until you turn on Start Jarvis at boot. After a computer restart, Resume brings back the Jarvis session and its agent fleets and coding tasks.

audio.label: Audio
audio.hint: Jarvis closes its microphone while it speaks
audio.info: Echo cancellation is not supported. Press Talk to interrupt speech.

browserDriver.label: Browser driver
browserDriver.hint: Jarvis drives its private browser with agent-browser

browser.label: Browser
browser.hint: Your approval lets Jarvis act as you on one site
browser.info: Approval applies only to that site.

tasks.label: Coding tasks
tasks.hint: Coding tasks whose agent is starting or running

input.label: Desktop input
input.hint: Jarvis does not click or type on VGS panels, the lock screen or password prompts, including the empty space around them, and it acts only in apps that the app launcher lists

setupHome.label: Home folder
setupHome.hint: Choose the folder Jarvis reads in [Home folder](page:vgs.jarvis/Settings/home)
setupHome.info: Your Home folder holds what Jarvis knows about you: your instructions, your memory notes and your skills. To use another folder, change [Home folder in Settings](page:vgs.jarvis/Settings/home).

setupModel.label: AI model
setupModel.hint: Jarvis uses the AI model to answer you

setupVoice.label: Voice
setupVoice.hint: Jarvis uses the selected voice provider to hear you and speak
setupVoice.info: Voice is how Jarvis hears you and speaks to you. The local voice keeps your speech on this computer. When this row asks for a step, do it so Jarvis can hear you.

setupFleet.label: Agent fleet
setupFleet.hint: The mail tool in your Jarvis home folder sends requests to your agent fleet

copilotMemory.label: Copilot Memory
copilotMemory.hint: Set Copilot Memory to Disabled in GitHub Copilot settings
copilotMemory.info: GitHub keeps this memory in your account. Only you can turn it off.
